title: Port of LA Hits Three-Month Record as Cargo Peak Stretches On
summary: The Port of Los Angeles just completed its busiest three-month run on record, as the early peak season stretched through August and importers navigated changing tariff policies and extreme weather across the globe.

title: Citadel Securities Urges SEC to Take Oversight of Some Wagers
summary: Citadel Securities told regulators that prediction market contracts linked to publicly-traded companies should be overseen by the Securities and Exchange Commission instead of the agency that has taken responsibility for them so far, the Commodity Futures Trading Commission.

title: Asian Stocks to Fall as Oil Stokes Inflation Fears: Markets Wrap
summary: Asian stocks were poised to decline Thursday, tracking losses on Wall Street as surging oil prices and Treasury yields stoked inflation concerns ahead of key US price data. US oil extended its rally to an eighth straight session.

title: Carney Woos Investors on Deals for Data Centers, Mines and LNG
summary: Canada plans to show some of the world’s biggest investors a pitchbook laying out tens of billions of dollars worth of projects spanning data centers, advanced manufacturing, liquefied natural gas, ports and dozens of mines.

title: Energy Transfer Switches Listing to Texas From NYSE, WSJ Says
summary: Pipeline giant Energy Transfer LP plans to move its primary listing to the Texas Stock Exchange from the New York Stock Exchange, according to the Wall Street Journal, a major win for the upstart marketplace as it seeks to upend the listing business.
